item.title: Ego-Curation
item.description: Building a pipeline that curates egocentric video datasets (e.g., Ego4D) using V-JEPA 2.1 prediction error to surface the most surprising segments of each video.

item.title: RobustNet
item.description: Implemented a ResNet from scratch using best-practice training techniques, then integrated conformal prediction at inference to output a prediction set rather than a single label—for more robust and trustworthy predictions.

item.title: Seq2Seq Model from Scratch
item.description: Implemented a sequence-to-sequence translation system with a focus on preprocessing, training stability, and inference speed.

item.title: Alzheimer's Disease Modeling with PINNs
item.description: Built physics-informed neural network experiments to explore disease progression and interpretable reaction terms using PDEs and symbolic regression.

item.title: How to get a classification model to say "I don't know"?
item.description: Conformal Prediction (CP) is one of the most interesting approaches for building trustworthy AI models. Let’s see what it is and how to use it with a classification model.
